name: Jessica O'Neil's Hard News
source:
The story about a 25 years old woman, Jessica O’Neil, trying to make a career as an investigative journalist at a newspaper. After working for a local TV channel for a couple of years, she wants to dive into the deep waters and make an impact with her work. How far is she willing to go and what methods is she going to use is up to you, the player.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/stoperart]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
该故事讲述了25岁的女性杰西卡·奥尼尔 (Jessica O’Neil) 试图在一家报社成为调查记者的职业生涯。在当地一家电视频道工作了几年后，她想潜入深水区并通过她的工作产生影响。她愿意走多远，她会使用什么方法，都取决于你，玩家。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/stoperart]Patreon[/url]]
